description: This file defines REST API routes for managing insurance claims in the Fraud Detection Platform. It includes endpoints for listing claims, retrieving details, creating, updating, rescoring, fetching signals, and bulk CSV upload, integrating with a database backend and fraud scoring logic.

methods.name: str _generate_claim_number()
methods.description: Generates a unique claim number with a UUID-based suffix.

methods.name: list_claims( status: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by claim status"), risk_level: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by risk level: low/medium/high"), search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search in claim_number or description"), limit: int = Query(50, description="Max results", ge=1, le=200), offset: int = Query(0, description="Offset for pagination", ge=0), )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated, optionally filtered list of claims.

methods.name: get_claim(claim_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches detailed information of a specific claim by its UUID.

methods.name: create_claim(claim: ClaimCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new claim record manually and runs fraud scoring.

methods.name: update_claim(claim_id: str, claim: ClaimUpdate)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing claim identified by its UUID.

methods.name: rescore_claim(claim_id: str)
methods.description: Re-runs fraud scoring on an existing claim.

methods.name: get_claim_signals(claim_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves all fraud signals for a specific claim.

methods.name: upload_csv(file: UploadFile = File(...))
methods.description: Processes a CSV file upload to bulk ingest multiple claims and score them.

ctags.name: list_claims
ctags.signature: ( status: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by claim status"), risk_level: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by risk level: low/medium/high"), search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search in claim_number or description"), limit: int = Query(50, description="Max results", ge=1, le=200), offset: int = Query(0, description="Offset for pagination", ge=0), )
